description.text: The second yearly Happy Meal promotion. From 15 June to 5 July 2012, each Pokémon Black•White Happy Meal in North America held one of 12 cards with a McDonald's M foil stamp on the picture, and one of six figures. Later in 2012 it went on to other major markets, Europe and Canada among them.

sources.title: Franchising.com: Pokémon-Themed Happy Meals Return to McDonald's Locations across North America (the 2012 press release)
